about: The 2026-10-11 demo's spoken journey, replayed through the real GPT-Live on test footage (docs/bench/voice-journeys.md). One Talk session, about 10 minutes. kind: view (a question the eyes should answer), plural (many of a thing), act, close, photo, side (said to an audience: never a request), typed (asked in the chat after the session). The steps with a "from" replay failures from the live voice session of 2026-10-28 (Part 2.5): each names what it checks; "[[slnc N]]" in "say" is a pause of N ms in the recorded words (macOS say), so a request arrives in two pieces; status asks about work in progress; a short "wait" starts the next step while the voice is still answering.

steps.say: Are you seeing what I'm seeing?
What are those dark spots?
So this is the microscope I was telling you about. Pretty cool, right?
Highlight the biggest one.
Look again. What's in the middle?
What's the little dot?
What are those black dots?
Can you pull up a picture of a stoma?
Close the picture and highlight a stoma.
Close that.
What are we looking at now?
Are they moving fast?
Incredible.
Use the dino model to dissect that one.
Can you outline the cells?
steps.from: 2026-10-28 log lines 14-17: one outline's outcome was said three times; it is said once

steps.say: Can you find the data of the cell outlines and surface it?
steps.from: 2026-10-28 log lines 26-28: "I've brought up the measurements table" before any tool ran, and "nothing's outlined" after a table request; the answer says what was done, once, with no outline talk

steps.say: Now can you create a researcher that looks at the data on the table [[slnc 1500]] and creates an animation of it.
steps.from: 2026-10-28 log lines 76-83: one request split by a pause made two researchers; it makes one

steps.say: What's the status of our researcher?
steps.from: 2026-10-28 log lines 102-104: answered, then went on while the user spoke; the next step starts 2 s in

steps.say: No, not that one. The researcher, researcher number three.
steps.from: 2026-10-28 log lines 105-106: "why are you talking over me?"; the voice stops and listens

steps.say: Can you fit the table on that page more neatly so it feels like a [[slnc 1800]] like it's the data.
steps.from: 2026-10-28 log lines 69-71: a half-finished request answered before its end; it waits for the rest
